defs.def: to start doing sth; to do the first part of sth 开始；启动

ex.s: He and his wife began looking for a place in Manhattan.
ex.t: 他和妻子开始物色曼哈顿的一处住所。

ex.s: This is how I began my search for the conceptual history of sea level.
ex.t: 我就是这样开始探寻海平面的概念史的。

ex.s: I worried that they’d begin to think they’d made a mistake.
ex.t: 我担心他们会开始觉得自己犯了个错误。

ex.s: Who are the people mentioned at the beginning of paragraph 1?
ex.t: 第1段开头提到的是哪些人？

ex.s: So, after studying the techniques for a couple of years, he began offering them to pets.
ex.t: 因此，在研究了几年的技术之后，他开始将它们提供给宠物。

ex.s: A story which begins well will end well.
ex.t: 开头好的故事结尾也会好。

ex.s: “It’s just the beginning,” she thought.
ex.t: 但我对自己的能力过于乐观了。

ex.s: Soon Eva began to breathe hard, with her heart pounding and legs shaking.
ex.t: 但我对独立的需求驱使我坚持推进我的研究计划。

ex.s: Eventually, researchers made a prediction that progressive warming during the 21st and 22nd centuries would dry out the Arctic, and lakes would begin to shrink.
ex.t: 最终，研究人员做出预测：21和22世纪逐步变暖将使北极变干，湖泊将开始萎缩。

ex.s: About a decade ago, I noticed that she began to lose her hearing.
ex.t: 大约十年前，我注意到她开始丧失听力。

ex.s: As I began designing experiments, my committee members warned me about the challenges I would face.
ex.t: 当我开始设计实验时，我的委员会成员警告过我将会面临的挑战。

ex.s: The plants and animals in the eco-machine took the sludge as food and began to eat it!
ex.t: 生态机器中的植物和动物把污泥当作食物，开始吃掉它！

ex.s: Which of the four programs begins the earliest?
ex.t: 四个项目中哪个开始得最早？

ex.s: Across the 320 submissions, a pattern of categories the researchers call a “nature language” began to emerge.
ex.t: 在320份提交材料中，一种被研究人员称为“自然语言”的类别模式开始显现。

ex.s: What phenomenon does the author describe at the beginning of the text?
ex.t: 作者在文章开头描述了什么现象？

ex.s: As an artist who shares her journey on social media, I’m often asked by curious followers how to begin an art journey.
ex.t: 作为一名在社交媒体上分享自己历程的艺术家，我常被好奇的粉丝问到如何开启艺术之旅。

ex.s: And that’s why, however astonishing Project Debater may seem, the tradition that began with Socrates and Confucius will not end with artificial intelligence.
ex.t: 正因如此，无论Project Debater多么惊人，始于苏格拉底和孔子的传统不会随人工智能终结。

ex.s: Ziyad began preparations.
ex.t: 齐亚德开始做准备。

ex.s: I was standing by the car when a hummingbird flew to the center of our group and began hovering.
ex.t: 我站在车旁时，一只蜂鸟飞到我们这群人的中央，开始悬停。

ex.s: Yet what began as a recipe book became a kind of memoir.
ex.t: 然而，最初作为食谱书的东西变成了一本回忆录。

ex.s: I looked through the window of the charming little violin shop, and my heart began to race.
ex.t: 我透过那家迷人的小小提琴店的橱窗望去，我的心开始怦怦直跳。

ex.s: I began practicing the violin with great passion, and rose quickly in ability.
ex.t: 我开始充满热情地练习小提琴，能力迅速提升。

ex.s: When he walked in, the boy shouted proudly, “Hey, that's my bus driver!”They went into a quiet corner and began reading together.
ex.t: 当他走进去时，男孩骄傲地喊道："嘿，那是我的校车司机！"他们走进一个安静的角落，开始一起读书。

ex.s: Many beginning writers don't leave enough space to revise.
ex.t: 许多初级作家没有留下足够的修改空间。

ex.s: After taking a degree at Chichester University in Related Arts, Ginni began to travel the world, eventually getting work teaching English in Japan and Chile.
ex.t: 在Chichester大学获得相关艺术学位后，Ginni开始周游世界，最终在日本和智利找到了教英语的工作。

ex.s: With the efforts made by all sides, we began to understand each other better.
ex.t: 经过各方的努力，我们开始更好地理解彼此。

ex.s: How does Laura sound at the beginning of the conversation?
ex.t: Laura在对话开始时听起来怎样？

ex.s: Yet properly understood, the age of electricity is merely the second stage in the age of steam, which began a century earlier.
ex.t: 然而正确理解的话，电力时代仅仅是蒸汽时代的第二阶段，蒸汽时代开始于一个世纪前。

ex.s: It began earlier than proper thought.
ex.t: 它比人们认为的开始得更早。

ex.s: It began in Europe in the 1970s.
ex.t: 它于20世纪70年代在欧洲开始。

ex.s: It wasn’t until a couple of hours later that we opened the doors and began serving dinner.
ex.t: 直到几个小时后，我们才打开门，开始供应晚餐。

ex.s: My life as a tax-paying employed person began in middle school, when, for three whole days, I worked in a baking factory.
ex.t: 我作为一个纳税的上班族的生活始于中学时期，当时我在一家烘焙工厂工作了整整三天。

ex.s: We begin on 1st June with Manchester Camerata and Nicola Benedetti, presenting an amazing programme of Mozart pieces.
ex.t: 我们于6月1日开幕，由曼彻斯特室内乐团和尼古拉·本内代蒂呈现一套精彩的莫扎特作品节目。

ex.s: Zafirakou began the project at Alperton Community School, her place of work for the past twelve years.
ex.t: 扎菲拉库在阿尔珀顿社区学校启动了这个项目，那是她过去十二年工作的地方。

ex.s: Then, slowly, he began to nod his head.
ex.t: 然后，慢慢地，他开始点头。

ex.s: At the beginning of the year, the artist built a piece called“Strawpocalypse,” a pair of 10-foot-tall plastic waves, frozen mid-crash.
ex.t: 今年年初，这位艺术家创作了一件名为吸管末日的作品，一对10英尺高的塑料波浪，定格在撞击的瞬间。

ex.s: Then we began again.
ex.t: 然后我们重新开始。

ex.s: The beginning of change is upsetting.
ex.t: 变化的开始令人不安。

ex.s: We begin to see the interconnectedness of one thing to another in all aspects of our life, of ourselves and the universe.
ex.t: 我们开始看到，在我们生活、我们自己和宇宙的各个方面，一个事物与另一个事物相互关联。

ex.s: As I dreamt bigger, I began looking into college courses for Fashion Design and three months later I signed up for a part-time design course.
ex.t: 当我梦想更大的时候我开始关注大学里的时装设计课程三个月后我报名参加了一个兼职设计课程。

ex.s: How did the author feel about joining the OIC project in the beginning？
ex.t: 作者一开始对加入OIC项目有什么感受？

ex.s: When he was 16, Molai began to notice something    23    happening around his home.
ex.t: 16岁时，莫莱开始注意到家附近发生了一些__23__不寻常的事。

ex.s: Why did the phone boxes begin to go out of service in the 1980s?
ex.t: 为什么电话箱在1980年代开始停止服务？

ex.s: I began collecting newspaper articles about new species, new monkey, new spider…, and on and on they appear.
ex.t: 我开始收集关于新物种、新猴子、新蜘蛛……的报纸文章，它们源源不断地出现。

ex.s: I began a second drawer for more general discoveries: new cave system discovered with dozens of nameless species, four hundred species of bacteria found in the human stomach.
ex.t: 我开始了第二个抽屉，用来放更一般的发现：被发现的有几十种无名物种的新洞穴系统、在人体胃部发现的四百种细菌。

ex.s: The second drawer began to fill and as it did I wondered whether there were bigger discoveries out there, not just species, but life that depends on things thought to be useless, life even without DNA.
ex.t: 第二个抽屉开始装满，就在它装满时我想知道外面是否还有更大的发现，不只是物种，还有依赖被认为无用的东西生存的生命，甚至没有DNA的生命。

ex.s: Thus, I began my lifelong interest in making things.
ex.t: 于是，我开始了我终生的制作爱好。

ex.s: One way to begin is to answer your own excuses.
ex.t: 开始的方法之一是回应你自己的借口。

ex.s: His effort to reunite families with lost medals began with a Christmas gift from his mother, a Purple Heart with the name Corrado A.
ex.t: 他让家庭与丢失勋章重聚的努力，始于母亲送的一份圣诞礼物——一枚刻着科拉多·A之名的紫心勋章。

ex.s: The programme beginning in August will operate in
ex.t: 寻找当地合作伙伴      B .接收年轻志愿者

ex.s: It all began when Moore visited a bank with her dad.
ex.t: 这一切始于摩尔和父亲去银行办事。

ex.s: Unexpectedly, I’m face-to-face with the gorilla, who begins screaming at    62    top of her lungs.
ex.t: 出乎意料地，我与那只大猩猩面对面，它开始___62____声嘶力竭地尖叫。

ex.s: It was Monday morning, and the writing class had just begin.
ex.t: 那是星期一早晨，写作课刚刚开始。

ex.s: You might also begin to notice the effects not only on your health but in your pocket.
ex.t: 你也许还会开始注意到，这不仅影响你的健康，也影响你的钱包。

ex.s: I started doing anything I could to help them build a little （10）     ．Most important， I began to treat them like （11）     ． That summer， when the other teams enjoyed their （12）      ， we met every day and （13）     passing and kicking the football．
ex.t: 我开始尽我所能帮助他们建立一点（10）____。最重要的是，我开始把他们当作（11）____。那年夏天，当其他队伍享受他们的（12）____时，我们每天碰面，并（13）____传接和踢足球。

ex.s: There's a new frontier in 3D printing that's beginning to come into focus： food． Recent development has made possible machines that print， cook， and serve foods on a mass scale． And the industry isn't stopping there．
ex.t: 3D打印出现了一个新的前沿领域，正开始受到关注：食品。近期的发展使能够大规模打印、烹饪并供应食物的机器成为可能。而该行业并未止步于此。

ex.s: The students began complaining about how cold it would be.
ex.t: 后来他们都承认一开始确实感觉到了冷水。

ex.s: The California Department of Motor Vehicles began giving permits in April for companies to test truly self-driving cars on public roads.
ex.t: 加利福尼亚州机动车管理局于4月开始发放许可，允许公司在公共道路上测试真正的自动驾驶汽车。

ex.s: As one group of workers carried out the rubbish, another group began removing seats and other theater equipment in preparation for the building’s end.
ex.t: 当一组工人运走垃圾时，另一组工人开始拆除座椅和其他剧院设备，为建筑的终结做准备。

ex.s: The beginning of Benjamin’s life as an artist.
ex.t: 本杰明作为艺术家生活的开端。

ex.s: When he began practicing, he took it very     50      .
ex.t: 当他开始练习时，他非常___50___地对待它。

ex.s: By telling stories at the beginning.
ex.t: 所有公司看起来都不可阻挡。

ex.s: Hannah began to speak out about the homelessness in Manitoba and then in other provinces.
ex.t: 汉娜开始公开发声，谈论马尼托巴省乃至其他省份的无家可归问题。

ex.s: These adorable little hunters are just doing something that it's been in their nature since the beginning of time.
ex.t: 这些可爱的小猎手只是在做一件自远古起就刻在他们天性里的事。

ex.s: My first step of redefining success began with course registrations.
ex.t: 我重新定义成功的第一步始于课程注册。

ex.s: In March 2008, Ginni boarded a ship with 48 passengers she’d never met before, to begin the journey towards Antarctica.
ex.t: 2008年3月，金妮与48名素未谋面的乘客登上一艘船，开始了前往南极的旅程。

ex.s: Before the film began, each woman was asked to help herself to a snack.
ex.t: 电影开始前，每位女性都被邀请随意取用一份零食。

ex.s: In looking into the stories of biological discovery, I also began to find something else, a collection of scientists, usually brilliant occasionally half-mad, who made the discoveries.
ex.t: 第二个抽屉也开始填满了，当它填满时我在想是否还有更大的发现，不仅仅是物种，还有依赖于被认为无用的东西的生命，甚至是没有DNA的生命。

ex.s: But when no one else came forward, Taylor ran to Paris and began doing CPR, “It was scary.
ex.t: 但没有人上前时，泰勒跑向帕里斯开始做心肺复苏。“这很吓人。”

ex.s: In the beginning, it is flexible, but put it in a drawer for 20 years and it will become dry and easily broken," says Dr Ben Levine, a heart specialist at the University of Texas.
ex.t: 开始时它很有弹性，但把它在抽屉里放20年，它就会变干、容易断裂，"德克萨斯大学的心脏专家Ben Levine博士说。

ex.s: In the beginning，I dared myself to make a difference in the life of another person．Now that our project is over，I realize that I have affected not only one life，but ten．With our efforts，ten young boys and girls will now be able to further their education．
ex.t: 一开始我鼓起勇气想要改变另一个人的生活。现在我们的项目结束了，我意识到我影响的不只是一个生命，而是十个。通过我们的努力，十个年轻人现在将能够继续接受教育。

defs.def: to start to happen or exist, especially from a particular time 起始；开始存在（或进行）
to be sth first, before becoming sth else 起初是；本来是

ex.s: Begin to train your brain to look at strength before weakness.
ex.t: 列出你所有的成就和成绩。

defs.def: to have sth as the first part or the point where sth starts （从 … ）开始；（以 … ）为起点

ex.s: Although not a morning person, I begin my lesson with Angela and about twenty others at a Sydney community centre courtyard at 7 am.
ex.t: 虽然不是早起的人，我还是在早上7点和安吉拉以及另外约二十人在悉尼一个社区中心的院子里开始上课。

ex.s: We began preparing the food, from mixing salad dressing to separating frozen meat.
ex.t: 我们开始准备食物，从调制沙拉酱到分拣冷冻肉类。

ex.s: It is important to know from the beginning that there are a lot of highs and lows, and there is no such thing as overnight success.”
ex.t: 重要的是从一开始就明白，其中有不少高潮与低谷，没有一夜成名这回事。

ex.s: As Inglis and, later other businessmen, got to work, repurposed phone boxes began reappearing in cities and villages as people found new uses for them.
ex.t: 随着英格利斯以及后来的其他商人开始行动，被重新利用的电话亭重新出现在城乡各地，因为人们为它们找到了新用途。

ex.s: Directed sound is also beginning to appear in shopping centers and even at homes.
ex.t: 定向声音也开始出现在购物中心甚至家庭中。

ex.s: There's tension and anxiety from the beginning as Nick and Amy battle for your trust.
ex.t: 从一开始就有紧张感和焦虑感，尼克和艾米在争夺你的信任。

ex.s: “Almost every great love story and each big business deal begins with small talk,” he explains.
ex.t: "几乎每一段伟大的爱情故事和每一笔大生意都是从闲聊开始的，"他解释道。

ex.s: So even if emissions were to begin to decrease today, we would still face the challenge of adapting to climate change.
ex.t: 所以即使排放量从今天开始减少，我们仍将面临适应气候变化的挑战。

ex.s: More recently, the foundation began another  47  called National Red Scarf Day --- a day when people donate $20 and wear red scarves in support of Canada’s  48   and homeless.
ex.t: 最近，该基金会又发起了一项名为“全国红围巾日”的活动——这一天人们捐出20美元并戴上红围巾，以支持加拿大的____和无家可归者。

ex.s: In the more than five years since Hannah began her activities, she has received a lot of  51  .
ex.t: 在Hannah开始她的活动五年多以来，她收到了很多____51____。

ex.s: Before the heavy lifting began, the team assessed the root system and dug a five-foot-deep cylinder , measuring 40 feet in diameter, around the trunk to protect all essential roots.
ex.t: 在重型吊装开始前，团队先评估了根系，并在树干周围挖了一个深五英尺、直径40英尺的圆柱形坑，以保护所有重要的根部。

ex.s: After becoming an important part of many British streets, the phone boxes began disappearing in the 1980s, with the rise of the mobile phone sending most of them away to the junkyards.
ex.t: 在成为许多英国街道的重要组成部分后，电话亭从20世纪80年代开始逐渐消失，随着手机的兴起，大多数被送进了垃圾场。

ex.s: Every autumn, millions of these beautiful insects with fine black and orange wings begin a long and difficult journey.
ex.t: 每年秋天，数以百万计这些长着黑橙相间美丽翅膀的昆虫开始一段漫长而艰难的旅程。

ex.s: Since I began thinking about this project in August 2011, the issue of sea-level rise and the need to place it historically have only become more urgent: between then and the end of 2022 the global sea rose by almost 5 centimeters, about half of the overall rise recorded by satellites since 1993.
ex.t: 自从我在2011年8月开始思考这个项目，海平面上升的问题以及将其置于历史背景的必要性变得更加紧迫：从那时到2022年底，全球海平面上升了近5厘米，约为卫星自1993年以来记录的总升幅的一半。

ex.s: As I carried her up the blackberry-lined path toward my car where I kept a water bottle, she began to move.
ex.t: 当我抱着她沿种满黑莓的小路走向停着水瓶的车时，她开始动了起来。

ex.s: The story begins in the last years of the 18th century in Scotland, where Watt perfected "the machine that changed the world".
ex.t: 故事始于18世纪末的苏格兰，Watt在那里完善了"改变世界的机器"。

ex.s: In the past few years, an increasing number of people and organisations have begun coming up with plans to counter this trend.
ex.t: 过去几年里，越来越多的人和组织开始提出计划来遏制这一趋势。

ex.s: With our tender, hopeful skin, that is where we begin.
ex.t: 用我们温柔充满希望的皮肤我们在那里重新开始。

ex.s: However, Molai went looking on his own and   30    a nearby island where he began to plant trees.
ex.t: 然而，莫莱独自去寻找，___30___附近一座小岛，开始在那里种树。

ex.s: Since our twins began learning to walk, my wife and I have kept telling them that our sliding glass door is just a window.
ex.t: 自从我们的双胞胎开始学走路，我和妻子就一直告诉他们，我们的玻璃推拉门只是一扇窗户。

ex.s: All across the country, recovery centers have begun building Healing Gardens.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 全国各地，康复中心已开始建造疗愈花园。

ex.s: In Peru, local farmers around a mountain with a glacier that has already fallen victim to climate change have begun painting the entire mountain peak white in the hope that the added reflectiveness will restore the life-giving ice.
ex.t: 在秘鲁，一座山峰的冰川已成为气候变化的牺牲品，周围的当地农民开始把整个山顶漆成白色，希望增加的反射率能恢复那赋予生命的冰。

ex.s: This first contact was where my story began.
ex.t: 第一次接触就是我的故事的开始。

ex.s: What does the author point out at the beginning of the text?
ex.t: 作者在文章开头指出了什么？

ex.s: Our life story is something that starts coming together in our teenage years, when we begin to organise our lives into chapters around key events or life changes, and begin to see ourselves as both the central character and, to a varying extent, the story’s author.
ex.t: 我们的人生故事在青少年时期开始成形，那时我们开始把生活围绕关键事件或人生变化整理成一个个章节，并开始把自己视为故事的中心人物，并且在不同程度上也视为这个故事的创作者。

ex.s: The results are mixed For football and basketball，adding talented players to a team proves a good method，but only up to the point where 70% of the players are top talent；above that level, the team’s performance begins to decline.
ex.t: 对于足球和篮球来说，效果不一：为球队增添有天赋的球员被证明是个好办法，但仅限于70%的球员都是顶尖人才的程度；超过这一水平，球队的表现就开始下滑。

ex.s: For example, you can begin with expression such as Why don’t we …?
ex.t: 例如，你可以用像"Why don't we …?"这样的表达开头。
